description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for the sixth-order periodic Laplacian rule central_D2_6_periodic driven by problems/heat_1d_periodic_o6.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding of N (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). The manufactured solution exp(-alpha (2 pi)^2 t) cos(2 pi x) is the fundamental periodic mode; the operator is the exact circulant 6th-order Laplacian, so the mode decays with the discrete eigenvalue's O(dx^6) error and the L2/Linf errors at t=0.1 fall as O(h^6). The 7-point stencil requires N >= 7, so the sweep runs N = 8,16,32 (stopping before the O(h^6) error drops under the cross-binding reproducibility floor); with a 6th-order slope three resolutions already pin the order. Integrator tolerances are tightened to 1e-12/1e-14 so the tiny high-order errors stay spatial-dominated. This convergence sweep is the numeric cross-binding gate for the sixth-order rule; there is no standalone simulation-category case, because at any single resolution the O(h^6) error falls to the cross-binding integrator-agreement floor (compare-outputs simulation atol 1e-12), which this golden comparison (rtol 1e-4) handles correctly while the strict simulation-actuals check cannot.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
